usageNotes: Use this to update a pool's comment, or to add/remove VMs and storage resources from an existing pool. The caller must hold Pool.Allocate on /pool/{poolid} and also have the appropriate resource-level permissions (e.g. VM.Allocate) on each guest or storage being added or removed. To move a guest that already belongs to another pool, set allow-move=true; without it the request will be rejected if the guest is already pooled.

examples.summary: Add two VMs and a storage volume to pool 'devteam', moving VM 105 from its current pool if needed

tips: The 'vms' and 'storage' fields accept comma-separated lists (pve-vmid-list / pve-storage-id-list format).
Set 'delete': true to remove the listed VMs/storage from the pool rather than adding them — the pool itself is not deleted.
Returns null on success; any error (missing privilege, unknown poolid, guest already in another pool without allow-move) surfaces as an HTTP 4xx/5xx.
Pool membership controls ACL inheritance: guests in a pool inherit permissions granted at the /pool/{poolid} path.
